changes: Original scene layout and authored meshes retained; X handedness and UV orientation converted; browser PBR and KTX2 prepared. No source lightmaps were recovered; adapted browser lighting is used. Native terrain heights, painted layer weights and vegetation recovered; see terrain-report.json for static rendering adaptations. Spatial material LODs use 64 metre cells. Opaque surface geometry retained at all levels; no COLLAPSE decimation. Authored terrain vegetation geometry and colors are shared without flattening placements; GPU batches remain inside each spatial LOD root. Terrain patch normal maps are limited to 256 pixels for the browser texture budget; source color maps and editable source textures retain their prepared resolution. Seasonal event hierarchies excluded. Floor UVs retained at distance; small transparent overlays and terrain detail grass fade at the far LOD. Original courses use their authored frames and have separate SOURCE records. Practice and missions have separate IDs.
limitations: Appearance is adapted rather than lossless.
Source sphere/capsule colliders currently use conservative oriented boxes.
Target FPS on UHD 620 has not been measured.
Terrain layers are baked to static browser PBR; Unity wind animation is not reproduced.
Native detail density and atlases are retained as static crossed billboards with deterministic scatter, adapted tint and far-LOD fading; Unity random scatter and camera-facing animation differ.
Existing sphere/capsule collider approximation remains in effect.
